repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The candidate executes the valve close and email send in the `else` branch of the periodic cycle, causing them to fire every 60 seconds even after the initial condition is met. The IR specifies a `cycle` with no `until` or `break`, meaning it should repeat indefinitely, but the candidate's logic incorrectly includes the actions in the `else` block instead of only in the main body loop.
diagnosis.change_summary: Removed the `else` branch entirely. The IR `cycle` repeats the body indefinitely. The candidate's `else` block caused actions to fire on every iteration regardless of the `wait` condition, whereas the IR only repeats the body actions (`EmailProvider.SendMail`) after the initial `wait` and `call` are completed. The `valve_close` should only happen once at the start, then only `SendMail` repeats.
